title: SAFF Championships: India enter semifinals with 1-0 win over Maldives

ai.summary: India defeated Maldives 1-0 in a SAFF Championships group match to advance to the semifinals, with Suhail Ahmad Bhat scoring the only goal via penalty in the 38th minute.

facts.claim: India beat Maldives 1–0 to enter the semifinals of the South Asian Football Federation (SAFF) Championships
facts.quote: A dominant India beat Maldives 1–0 to enter the semifinals of the South Asian Football Federation (SAFF) Championships, following a first half strike by Suhail Ahmad Bhat in their Group B match here on Wednesday.

facts.claim: Suhail Ahmad Bhat scored the only goal via penalty in the 38th minute
facts.quote: Suhail Ahmad put India ahead with a 38th-minute penalty after Abdul Rabeeh was fouled in the box.

facts.claim: India needed a draw or win to guarantee a spot in the semifinals and top Group B
facts.quote: Heading into this game, India needed a draw or win to guarantee a spot in the semifinals and top Group B.

facts.claim: Pakistan has already qualified from the group with 3 points and a +2 goal difference after defeating Maldives 3-0
facts.quote: Pakistan has already qualified from the group with 3 points and a +2 goal difference after defeating Maldives 3-0.
